subject: Onsite demo + SF exec dinner - scheduling and reschedule
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>, samantha.li@fastscale.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - availability

Ben / Redwood team -

Thanks for the quick follow up. We'd love to host the onsite demo the week of June 22 in our SF office and get an exec dinner scheduled the evening before for a subset of our leadership team. High-level asks from my side:
- 90min technical demo (AE + SE) with our platform engineers and security lead in attendance
- 30min business exec sync + dinner with VP Product + Head of Engineering (approx 6 people)
- A short procurement checkpoint to confirm SOW/timeline after the demo

Our tentative attendee list: Samantha Li (Eng Manager), Marcus Green (Platform Eng), Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>, and myself. Can you share Redwood SE availability for the 21st evening (dinner) and 22nd daytime window (10am-3pm)?

Alex
Alex Morgan
Director, Partnerships
FastScale

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>, samantha.li@fastscale.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - availability

Alex -
Great, thanks for the outline. I can cover AE coordination and will bring Soojin (SE) for the deep technical portions. Dev (security/infra) will join the security Q&A.

Availability:
- Dinner (Mon 21 Jun): Ben + Soojin are free after 6:30pm; Dev might need to arrive at 7pm.
- Onsite demo (Tue 22 Jun): 10:00-11:30 or 1:30-3:00 both work for our team.

I've attached a draft visit agenda and demo plan to help structure the day (SF-visit-agenda.pdf, MVP-demo-plan.xlsx). If those windows look good, I can send a calendar hold and coordinate travel details for Soojin and Dev.

Next steps: please confirm which dinner time/location and which demo slot your engineering team prefers. Also confirm if a security packet or an NDA is needed before the demo.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>
Cc: sian@fastscale.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - SOW and procurement items

Ben / Alex -

Procurement here - quick note on timelines. We need a preliminary SOW draft and standard security questionnaire responses by June 19 to get internal approvals ahead of the onsite visit. Billing contact is procurement@fastscale.com. Also confirm whether Redwood will require any visitor access requests for the SF office (badging).

If you can drop the SOW + SOC 2 summary by Friday (19th), we can try to get procurement signoff the week of the demo.

Thanks,
Sian Patel
Senior Procurement Manager

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - SOW and procurement items

Sian / Alex / Ben -

I'll upload the standard SOC 2 summary and a short security packet (redwood-security-overview.pdf) by EOD tomorrow. For badging: Redwood team will use standard visitor check-in unless FastScale needs us to pre-register names - if so, send the list and I'll confirm.

Also, quick note: Soojin and I are booked for a different customer briefing on the 22nd 1:00-2:00pm PST. That conflicts with the 1:30-3:00 slot Ben proposed. We should keep the 10:00-11:30 slot as our primary to avoid travel issues.

Dev Patel
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>, Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - scheduling confirmation

Thanks Dev - good catch. Alex, can we lock in Tue 22 Jun 10:00-11:30 for the technical demo (Sooj/Dev present)? For dinner on Mon 21 Jun, how does 7pm at The Cavalier (near your office) sound for the exec group? We'll plan for 6 guests total.

I'll send calendar invites and a small agenda once you confirm. Also, Sian, we'll have the SOW draft and security packet to you by Friday 19th - sending DocuSign link once it's ready.

Best,
Ben

From: Alex Morgan <alex@fastscale.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastscale.com>, samantha.li@fastscale.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo + exec dinner - scheduling confirmation

Ben -

Confirmed. Tue 22 Jun 10:00-11:30 is good for the demo; Mon 21 Jun 7pm at The Cavalier works for dinner. I'll send a private invite to the execs and share attendee names for pre-registration (Sian, will send the list shortly). Looking forward to it.

Alex
